Each Cell stores:
• Best operator sequence [A₁,...,Aₖ]
• Optimized angles θ*
• Energy E* = ⟨ψ₀|U†HU|ψ₀⟩
• Generation (epoch discovered)
• Visit count

span.p:
Coverage Tracking:
• λ = 1.0 when coverage < 25%
• λ = 0.5 when coverage 25–50%
• λ = 0.1 when coverage > 50%
• λ = 0.0 when coverage > 80%
